import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long binPow(long base, int exp, int mod) {
        long result = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        if (n % 2 == 1) {
            System.out.println(binPow(k, n, p));
            return;
        }

        long[] fact = new long[n + 1];
        long[] inv_fact = new long[n + 1];
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % p;
        }
        inv_fact[n] = binPow(fact[n], p - 2, p);
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv_fact[i] = (inv_fact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % p;
        }

        long[][] g = new long[n + 1][17];
        g[0][0] = 1;

        int[] cnt = {0};

        class Solver {
            void solve(int nVal, List<Integer> bits, int kIdx, int mask) {
                if (kIdx == bits.size()) {
                    cnt[0]++;
                    for (int i = 1; i < 17; i++) {
                        g[nVal][i] += inv_fact[mask] * g[nVal ^ mask][i - 1];
                        if (cnt[0] >= 8) g[nVal][i] %= p;
                    }
                    if (cnt[0] >= 8) cnt[0] = 0;
                    return;
                }
                solve(nVal, bits, kIdx + 1, mask);
                solve(nVal, bits, kIdx + 1, mask ^ (1 << bits.get(kIdx)));
            }
        }

        Solver solver = new Solver();

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if ((i & n) != i) continue;
            List<Integer> bits = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < 18; j++) {
                if (((1 << j) & i) != 0) {
                    bits.add(j);
                }
            }
            if (!bits.isEmpty()) {
                solver.solve(i, bits, 1, 1 << bits.get(0));
            }
        }

        long answer = 0;
        int limit = Math.min(16, k);
        for (int i = 1; i <= limit; i++) {
            g[n][i] %= p;
            long temp = fact[n] * g[n][i] % p;
            temp = temp * fact[k] % p;
            temp = temp * inv_fact[k - i] % p;
            answer = (answer + temp) % p;
        }

        long total = binPow(k, n, p);
        answer = total - answer;
        if (answer < 0) answer += p;
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
